privacy.title: Employee Personal Data Processing Notice
privacy.body: The identity (name, national ID), contact (email, phone) and employment data (hire date, title, department, payroll and leave records) processed through this platform are processed in order to establish and perform your employment contract and to fulfill legal obligations, under Article 5(2)(c) and (ç) of Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 — this processing does not rely on your consent, but on those legal grounds. Your data is stored securely for the duration of your employment and for the retention periods required by law. Under Article 11 of the Law, you have the right to access your personal data, request correction or deletion, and object to automated processing; you can direct such requests to your HR department.
privacy.draftNotice: This text is a draft pending legal/HR review. If it changes after review, the version number increases and your consent is requested again.
privacy.outdated: The privacy notice has been updated. Please refresh the page and accept it again.
